scope: Store current-authority continuation for the existing ICE attempt; no physical RTC or public dispatch runtime claim.

implementation.origin: Opaque Store-issued attribution to original full credential chain/command, key, member epoch, Endpoint, effect, connection generation, physical runtime ID and InstallationOwnership. No owned authority reader is retained.
implementation.resume: Fresh bounded admission capped by original proof/lease expiry, followed by exact original Preparing attempt/current WebRTC source validation. Creates no attempt/effect. Wrong credential/effect/runtime, withdrawn membership and Unknown attempt refuse.

verification.source_fence: Source hashes recorded after run, not a before/after execution inventory.
verification.behavior: Reacquisition releases readers between observations (a real identity writer is acquired); original expiry is never extended; effect count stays unchanged; membership/Unknown/wrong credential/effect/restored-runtime negatives.

remaining: Complete physical worker and exact original answer delivery with current policy
